title: Car Listing Creation
preconditions: Seed state; active user is Owner
steps: Open My Listings and choose Add listing

Enter Make Tesla, Model Model Y, Year 2023, Daily rate 85, Pickup location (pickup address) Airport Hub, city Miami, plus other required fields (cleaning fee 25, seats 5, Electric, Automatic, image URL)
Save the listing
Switch to Renter and open the marketplace
expected: Listing is saved with a success message
A Tesla Model Y 2023 card at $85/day appears immediately in the marketplace with a location badge containing Airport Hub

title: Search and Filtering
preconditions: Seed state; active user is Renter
steps: Open the marketplace
Filter by Make Tesla
Set Max daily price to 90
expected: Only cars with brand Tesla and daily rate <= 90 are displayed; Ford Bronco and BMW M3 disappear without page reload

title: Dynamic Pricing
preconditions: Seed state; active user is Renter
steps: Open Tesla Model Y
Choose start 2026-12-01 and end 2026-12-04 (3 days)
expected: Breakdown shows 3 days, daily rate $85.00, subtotal $255.00, cleaning fee $25.00, total $280.00

title: Owner Booking Approval
preconditions: Seed state; active user is Renter
steps: Book Tesla Model Y for 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-04 and submit
Switch to Owner account and open Booking Requests
Approve the pending booking
Check the owner bookings list, then switch to Renter and open My Bookings
expected: Both owner and renter dashboards show the booking as Confirmed

title: Booking Conflict Prevention
preconditions: Seed state: car_01 has confirmed booking book_301 from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-13
steps: As Renter open Tesla Model Y
Choose start 2026-11-11 and end 2026-11-14
Attempt to submit
expected: Submission is blocked with a clear error message about the dates conflicting with a confirmed booking; no new booking is created

title: Data Persistence
steps: As Owner create a new car listing
As Renter create a booking request for a car
Reload the page
Check marketplace, My Bookings, and Owner dashboard
expected: The new listing and the new booking are still present with the same details and statuses after reload
